messages:
Iris: Filing a small docs PR to add a 'VPC -> Sealed Edge' migration appendix: network diffs, best-practice firewall rules, and an HSM slot-mapping recipe. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4402. Asking eng-runtime + security for quick eyes.
Tom: Nice. Can you also add the concrete iproute2 examples we hand to customers? They copy them into runbooks.
Iris: Will do. Drafting a short section with ip route, conntrack, and a sample nftables NAT rule.
Iris: iproute example:```bash
# ensure correct source routing on dual-homed host
ip route add 10.0.0.0/16 via 192.168.1.1 dev eth1 src 192.168.1.10
# check routes
ip route show table all | grep 10.0.0.0/16
```
Hannah: For conntrack, include the one-liner to dump recent entries and a hint to increase conntrack max for large bursts. Ops always need that.
Iris: Added:```bash
# list conntrack entries related to the control-plane
sudo conntrack -L | grep {{ REDWOOD_API_HOST }} || echo "no entries"
# bump conntrack (example)
echo 262144 > /proc/sys/net/netfilter/nf_conntrack_max
```
Tom: For nftables, show a minimal masquerade rule for offline nodes that must reach the control plane via NAT.
Iris: nft snippet:```nft
table ip rwinf_nat {
  chain postrouting {
    type nat hook postrouting priority 100;
    ip saddr 10.10.0.0/16 oifname "eth0" masquerade
  }
}
```
Iris: HSM/PKCS#11 appendix: recommend keeping a slot map artifact in repo and an example YAML + a quick pkcs11-tool check.
Iris: YAML example:```yaml
# hsm_slot_map.yaml
version: 1
keys:
  - key_alias: rw-root
    token_serial: "SN123456"
    label: REDWOOD_ROOT
    preferred_slot: 1
  - key_alias: tenant-ops
    token_serial: "SN987654"
    label: TENANT_OPS
    preferred_slot: 2
```
Hannah: Add a note to prefer token_serial+label fallback instead of slot index only — some HSMs change slot numbers after firmware updates.
Iris: Added. Also included this quick pkcs11 command for preflight:```bash
pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/libpkcs11.so --list-slots --token-info | egrep -A2 "Token and slot" || true
```
security-bot: Automated doc-scan: flagged use of absolute internal host in one snippet. Recommend `{{ REDWOOD_API_HOST }}` placeholders. Ran at 2026-03-22T15:20Z.
eng-runtime-bot: Perf note: for sealed edge we suggest reducing default KV cache retention to 128MB on small instances. Consider adding a short note in the migration appendix.
Iris: Good catch 1 added a short guidance paragraph for cache size and batch sizing for constrained hosts.
Tom: Can we include a tiny troubleshooting table for "cannot reach control plane" covering: DNS, CA bundle, firewall, NTP skew? Two lines max.
Iris: Added a compact table (bullet list) with commands: `dig`, `openssl s_client -connect`, `curl --cacert`, `timedatectl status`. Also included a one-liner to check CA bundle: `openssl verify -CAfile /etc/redwood/ca.pem /etc/redwood/certs/client.pem`.
Priya: Tiny docs nit: use backticks for filenames in the install steps and avoid trailing periods in command lines. Also please link to the HSM compatibility matrix (docs/hsm-compat.md).
Iris: Fixed formatting and added the link. Also updated the PR description with a short changelog and the QA checklist we used.
Tom: I'll review and leave inline comments on wording. If security-bot is happy and eng-runtime approves the cache note, we can merge.
Iris: Thanks 1 aiming to merge after approvals and will post a short announcement in #eng-docs.
